1. (Currently amended) Claim 281: A tool comprising a lamination of at least two layers and at least two adhesive layers, the tool comprising first and second layers and __a medial section between the first and second layers__, a first adhesive layer configured to be cured on the first layer, a second adhesive layer configured to be cured on the second layer, the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer configured to be cured to each other, the tool has a circular shape and includes a plurality of arc-shaped cutting segments having an inner arc shape and an outer arc shape, wherein the inner arc shape of each of the arc-shaped cutting segments is directly affixed to an outer perimeter of the first and second layers, __wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are located on opposite sides of the medial section and the first layer and the second layer are aligned with the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer__.

2. (Currently amended) Claim 282: The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section comprises a metal.

3. (Currently amended) Claim 283: The tool of claim 282, wherein the metal is a honeycomb structure.

4. (Currently amended) Claim 284: The tool of claim 282, wherein the medial section is a composite material.

5. (Currently amended) Claim 285: The tool of claim 281, further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers, wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section, wherein the plurality of cutting segments are also welded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring, and wherein the weld ring is continuous.

6. (Currently amended) Claim 286: The tool of claim 285, wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section.

7. (Currently amended) Claim 287: The tool of claim 285, wherein the plurality of cutting segments are welded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring.

8. (Currently amended) Claim 288: The tool of claim 285, wherein the weld ring is continuous.

9. (Currently amended) Claim 289: The tool of claim 285, wherein the weld ring is segmented.

10. (Currently amended) Claim 290: The tool of claim 285, further including an inner ring, wherein the medial section is coupled on an inner perimeter to the inner ring.

11. (Currently amended) Claim 291: The tool of claim 290, wherein the inner ring includes __a__ central opening for accommodating a drive shaft.

12. (Currently amended) Claim 293: The tool of claim 281, further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers and the plurality of cutting segments, such that the plurality of cutting segments are located on an outer periphery of the weld ring, and wherein the weld ring is continuous.

13. (Currently amended) Claim 294: The tool of claim 293, wherein the weld ring is continuous.

14. (Currently amended) Claim 295: The tool of claim 293, wherein the weld ring is segmented.
